lead.headline: Cade Cunningham Drops 52 as Detroit Outlasts Washington in Double Overtime
lead.subhead: Cunningham poured in 52 points and the Pistons survived a 144-140 two-overtime thriller in D.C., the highest-scoring game of the season. When regulation wasn't enough, he kept going, and then went again. Closers don't stop at the buzzer.

articles.hed: Diggs Scores With 57 Seconds Left, Commanders Stun Giants
articles.body: Jayden Daniels shook off two interceptions and hit Stefon Diggs for a 32-yard go-ahead touchdown with 57 seconds left, a 24-21 win in a must-win game. Bad quarters don't decide the night; the last drive does.
Tyrese Maxey had 27 points and 8 assists as Philadelphia handled Toronto 123-112. Steady work, stacked wins, top of the conversation in the East.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Friday, the day of Venus. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Venus rules attraction and relationships, the exact things that close deals. Breathe slow, get magnetic, then go finish the week.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go close out Friday.

mindset.body: Cade Cunningham didn't stop at 40, and he didn't stop when regulation ended. He went to a second overtime and finished with 52. Friday is your overtime. Most people coast into the weekend; that's exactly when the closer makes the extra call, sends the follow-up, and books Monday. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Friday, the day of Venus: run this right after Morning Charge. It's about 32° and clear outside, so keep the RipStick finisher indoors or make it a quick, brave porch set. Finish the week with clean reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

Friday takes its name from Frigg and its Latin name from Venus, planet of attraction, harmony and favor. Old grimoires set it aside for workings of love and friendship. In business terms: relationships. Strengthen one today.

items.hed: Hermes Trismegistus and the Emerald Tablet
items.body: 'As above, so below' comes from a short Hermetic text prized by alchemists for centuries. The idea is that the inner order shapes the outer one. Get your head straight and your day lines up behind it.

The 12th-century abbess, mystic and composer wrote of viriditas, the 'greening power' of life pushing through everything. She ran a monastery, wrote medicine and music, and advised kings. Growth is a force; ride it.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings' (Proverbs 22:29). Skill plus consistency gets you in rooms that talent alone never opens. Finish the week like it matters, because it does.
